claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_or_qualitative_effect: Conceptual process repository; no realized governance/ROI outcome evidence.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.quote_or_location: Abstract: "Develop a CubeSat Project Model that models how CubeSat design and development are to be accomplished." Section 3: "The CubeSat Project Model... will be a repository for these processes, methods, and tools."
threats_or_alternative_explanations: Project Model is described in future tense.
No completed process repository or decision-gate use is demonstrated.

governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.governance_details: Diagrams identify the INCOSE SSWG CubeSat Challenge Team as creator; team uses teleconferences and shared Google Docs for materials/notes; future model roll-out is controlled through an MBSE workshop and feedback/update loop. Configuration/change control, naming/versioning conventions and explicit model quality criteria are not reported.

Systems-engineering artifacts may be extracted to demonstrate mission assurance to stakeholders.

lightweight_resource_constrained_tailori.rationale: Tailored to CubeSat standards and MBSE-new teams; no resource/cost/schedule evidence.
evidence: Cal Poly CDS basis.

governance_project_deliverables_roi.rationale: Model artifacts are linked to mission assurance, requirements traceability and verification signoff; ROI evidence is absent.
evidence: Artifacts extracted for mission assurance.

newspace_agile_distributed_rapid_iterati.rationale: Distributed team practices are reported, but no NewSpace/agile/rapid-iteration MBSE method or outcome is discussed.
evidence: Weekly teleconferences and shared Google Docs folder.
No agile/NewSpace process claim.

key_findings_relevant_to_rq1: Strongly relevant to general CubeSat system-level modeling: proposes reusable SysML CubeSat Reference Model and Project Model spanning space/ground systems, subsystems, stakeholders, domains, external constraints and lifecycle stages.

Modeling with minimal mission-specific detail is supported through logical architecture, stakeholder/requirements flowdown, component library, and customization guidance, but not as a formal minimal-behavior method.
key_findings_relevant_to_rq2: MBSE outcomes claimed: reuse/reproducibility via starting model, integrability via COTS tool interfaces, consistency/traceability via cohesive requirements/design/verification source, decision support via RAX trade studies.
Power/EPS evidence is limited to system-level power components and RAX power/energy trade studies; no EPS reliability/integrability/reproducibility outcome evidence is measured.
key_findings_relevant_to_rq3: Verification/validation are part of the intended reference model and project model, and requirements flowdown is shown.
No EPS-specific pre-physical verification procedure, test artifact, acceptance criterion, SIL/HIL link or automated check is reported.
author_stated_limitations_gaps: RAX Phase 1 model was not intended to be accurate.
Phase 2 lacked ability to time-step through behavior and determine requirement satisfaction throughout the mission.
Current effort to date focuses on nomenclature, stakeholders/MOEs and logical subsystems; lifecycle model definition and concept/development models are next steps.
Validation on hypothetical CirrusSat and controlled roll-out are future work.
extractor_identified_limitations_gaps: No quantitative MBSE outcome evaluation, baseline or comparator.
No model availability or exchange mechanism sufficient for independent replication.
No EPS-specific integrated V&V model or pre-physical verification evidence.
Potential bibliographic author mismatch between prompt metadata and markdown header.
Prior lineage evidence could be double-counted if earlier SSWG CubeSat/RAX papers are also included.
direct_evidence_quotes_supporting_classi: "Develop a CubeSat Reference Model that other projects can use as a starting point for their mission specific CubeSat model."
"The reference model contains SysML elements for the requirements, design, analysis, verification, and validation activities."
"The past phases have demonstrated that it is possible to interface SysML with special purpose M&S tools..."
"The effort to date has been focused on establishing nomenclature... and defining the architecture down to the logical subsystems."
"The model will be validated by applying it to a hypothetical CirrusSat mission..."
synthesis_consistency.notes_for_consistency_with_lineage: Treat as the 2015 interim-status/current-phase SSWG CubeSat Reference Model paper. Prior RAX simulation/trade evidence should be attributed to lineage and not double-counted against earlier 2012-2014 papers if separately extracted.
synthesis_consistency.extraction_confidence_rationale: The full converted paper is available and provides clear claims/artifacts, but it is interim, mostly conceptual, lacks detailed outcome evidence, and has corpus-vs-markdown author discrepancy.

repair_notes: Remove low-dynamics / non-detailed-behavior model from generality_reuse_mechanism; the paper is interim but does not state low-detailed behavior as the reuse mechanism.

Set IVV integration to not_reported rather than uncertain/model-integrated; V&V is only conceptual/future and no integrated IVV artifact is shown.
